findings.description: The boundary map row for sc-decision-local lists allowed sc-agent dependencies as types, secrets, log, http and schema. The a-6 sprint doc (line 222) and ADR-SAG-0004 add sc-decision-systemone and sc-agent-config (RunnerKind, RunnerHost). The sc-decision-runner row lists config, so the plan's map is also inconsistent in what it shows per row. The a-6 doc and the ADR are consistent with each other, so this is not an ADR violation. The Sprints table 'Depends on' column (a-6, a-7, a-9 show a-2 only) is narrower than the 'Every must_follow edge' table, which is the authoritative one.
findings.remediation: Add sc-decision-systemone and config to the sc-decision-local row. State that the edge table, not the 'Depends on' column, is authoritative for start conditions.
